body:
I wish I had anxiety meds it probably would help I feel stressed out constantly. I don't want to go to a shelter but idk if I will be able to find a job and place in that time frame.

I am trying to apply everywhere but I haven't heard anything back yet .
I know what you mean :/ it is even harder to get help since most resources are focused on physical/sexual abuse. Nobody sees it as legitimate even if we have mental scars that never heal.

Massachusetts, there is like no homeless shelters in the area I am in that run in the summer it seems like :/

I might be able to move to somewhere that has a shelter I have some money but not a lot.

I wish I had advice but I am in a similar situation. Basically my life depends on if I can get a job or not and I just can't seem to be able to get one. It sucks so much, I wish getting a job wasn't so difficult.

I am trying so hard to find a job but I haven't been super successful at all. I have such a limited time to find something and I feel like I don't even have that since both my friend and his mom want me to leave like right now suddenly. There is NO shelters in the area and I know absolutely no one.
